<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>鹈鹕骑自行车 🐦🚲</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;background:#87ceeb;overflow:hidden;}
  svg{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg id="stage" viewBox="0 0 1280 800" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8fd3f4"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#cdeefb"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e8f6ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sun" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff3b0"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffe27a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffd23f"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ground" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9fd87f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6fbf52"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- 天空 -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="800" fill="url(#sky)"/>

  <!-- 太阳 -->
  <circle cx="1120" cy="110" r="70" fill="url(#sun)"/>

  <!-- 云 -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92">
    <g id="cloud1">
      <ellipse cx="220" cy="140" rx="70" ry="30"/>
      <ellipse cx="270" cy="125" rx="55" ry="34"/>
      <ellipse cx="180" cy="128" rx="45" ry="28"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
        values="0 0; 40 0; 0 0" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline"
        keyTimes="0;0.5;1" keySplines="0.4 0 0.6 1;0.4 0 0.6 1"/>
    </g>
    <g id="cloud2">
      <ellipse cx="640" cy="90" rx="80" ry="32"/>
      <ellipse cx="700" cy="78" rx="60" ry="36"/>
      <ellipse cx="590" cy="80" rx="50" ry="30"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
        values="0 0; -50 0; 0 0" dur="12s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline"
        keyTimes="0;0.5;1" keySplines="0.4 0 0.6 1;0.4 0 0.6 1"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- 风吹线条 -->
  <g stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="60" y1="300" x2="240" y2="300">
      <animate attributeName="x1" values="60;-120;60" dur="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="x2" values="240;60;240" dur="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.8;0" dur="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </line>
    <line x1="120" y1="380" x2="300" y2="380">
      <animate attributeName="x1" values="120;-60;120" dur="1.5s" begin="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="x2" values="300;120;300" dur="1.5s" begin="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.7;0" dur="1.5s" begin="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </line>
    <line x1="40" y1="460" x2="220" y2="460">
      <animate attributeName="x1" values="40;-140;40" dur="1.5s" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="x2" values="220;40;220" dur="1.5s" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.6;0" dur="1.5s" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </line>
  </g>

  <!-- 地面 -->
  <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="160" fill="url(#ground)"/>

  <!-- 路面 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="34" fill="#4a4a52"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="657" x2="1280" y2="657" stroke="#f5d76e" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="40 30">
      <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="0;-70" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </line>
  </g>

  <!-- 自行车与鹈鹕 整体平移(轻微上下颠簸) -->
  <g id="bike">
    <!-- 后轮 -->
    <g id="wheelR">
      <circle cx="380" cy="600" r="95" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="14"/>
      <circle cx="380" cy="600" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#3a3a3a" stroke-width="4"/>
      <g class="spokes" transform-box="fill-box" transform-origin="center" style="animation:spin 1.2s linear infinite;">
        <line x1="380" y1="510" x2="380" y2="690" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
        <line x1="290" y1="600" x2="470" y2="600" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
        <line x1="316" y1="536" x2="444" y2="664" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
        <line x1="316" y1="664" x2="444" y2="536" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="380" cy="600" r="12" fill="#222"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 前轮 -->
    <g id="wheelF">
      <circle cx="760" cy="600" r="95" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="14"/>
      <circle cx="760" cy="600" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#3a3a3a" stroke-width="4"/>
      <g class="spokes" transform-box="fill-box" transform-origin="center" style="animation:spin 1.2s linear infinite;">
        <line x1="760" y1="510" x2="760" y2="690" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
        <line x1="670" y1="600" x2="850" y2="600" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
        <line x1="696" y1="536" x2="824" y2="664" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
        <line x1="696" y1="664" x2="824" y2="536" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="760" cy="600" r="12" fill="#222"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 车架（红色，五根线） -->
    <g stroke="#e0392b" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
      <line x1="380" y1="600" x2="560" y2="560"/>
      <line x1="380" y1="600" x2="500" y2="430"/>
      <line x1="560" y1="560" x2="505" y2="415"/>
      <line x1="560" y1="560" x2="700" y2="420"/>
      <line x1="505" y1="430" x2="700" y2="420"/>
      <line x1="700" y1="420" x2="760" y2="600"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 牙盘/五通中心 -->
    <circle cx="560" cy="560" r="26" fill="#333"/>
    <circle cx="560" cy="560" r="9" fill="#888"/>

    <!-- 曲柄与踏板 (JS 驱动) -->
    <g id="crank">
      <line id="crankArm" x1="560" y1="560" x2="615" y2="560" stroke="#222" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <rect id="pedal" x="600" y="552" width="34" height="16" rx="4" fill="#111"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 车座 -->
    <path d="M470 415 q35 -22 70 0 q-35 14 -70 0 Z" fill="#222"/>
    <line x1="505" y1="415" x2="505" y2="430" stroke="#e0392b" stroke-width="8"/>

    <!-- 车把弯头 -->
    <path d="M700 420 q10 -50 40 -50" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="740" cy="370" r="9" fill="#333"/>

    <!-- 鹈鹕 -->
    <g id="pelican">
      <!-- 尾巴 -->
      <g id="tail">
        <path d="M470 470 q-60 -10 -95 15 q55 5 90 -8 Z" fill="#eaf3ff" stroke="#b9d4ee" stroke-width="3"/>
      </g>
      <!-- 身体 (坐姿, 底边 y=470 压住座面) -->
      <path id="body" d="M470 470 q-15 -90 90 -95 q120 -6 135 60 q10 40 -25 55 q-110 35 -200 -20 Z"
            fill="#f4f9ff" stroke="#b9d4ee" stroke-width="4"/>
      <!-- 翅膀/手臂 前伸握车把 -->
      <g id="wing">
        <path d="M600 395 q70 -10 135 -25" fill="none" stroke="#dfeaf6" stroke-width="26" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="740" cy="370" r="14" fill="#f4f9ff" stroke="#b9d4ee" stroke-width="4"/>
      </g>
      <!-- 脖子 -->
      <path id="neck" d="M600 400 q10 -70 60 -120" fill="none" stroke="#f4f9ff" stroke-width="34" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <!-- 头 + 喙 + 喉囊 -->
      <g id="head">
        <circle cx="665" cy="278" r="42" fill="#f4f9ff" stroke="#b9d4ee" stroke-width="4"/>
        <!-- 喉囊 -->
        <path d="M690 295 q60 15 55 55 q-10 25 -45 12 q-25 -10 -15 -45 Z" fill="#ffd86b" stroke="#e8b84a" stroke-width="3"/>
        <!-- 长喙 -->
        <path d="M695 270 q75 10 110 40 q-40 12 -110 -2 Z" fill="#ffcf4d" stroke="#e8b84a" stroke-width="3"/>
        <!-- 眼睛 -->
        <circle cx="676" cy="268" r="7" fill="#222"/>
        <circle cx="678" cy="266" r="2.5" fill="#fff"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- 腿 (IK 驱动: 大腿 + 小腿) -->
    <g id="leg" stroke="#3a3a3a" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
      <line id="thigh" x1="545" y1="455" x2="560" y2="560"/>
      <line id="shin" x1="560" y1="560" x2="615" y2="550"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 脚 -->
    <circle id="foot" cx="615" cy="550" r="13" fill="#222"/>
  </g>

  <style>
    @keyframes spin { from{transform:rotate(0deg);} to{transform:rotate(360deg);} }
    @keyframes bob { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);} 50%{transform:translateY(-8px);} }
    @keyframes headsway { 0%{transform:rotate(-4deg);} 100%{transform:rotate(4deg);} }
    #bike { animation: bob 0.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
    #head { transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:20% 80%; animation: headsway 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    #tail { transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:100% 50%; animation: headsway 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  </style>
</svg>

<script>
(function(){
  // ===== 固定锚点 =====
  const HIP = {x:545, y:455};   // 胯部
  const CRANK_CENTER = {x:560, y:560}; // 五通中心
  const CRANK_LEN = 55;         // 曲柄长
  const PEDAL_R = 55;           // 踏板半径
  const THIGH_LEN = 95;         // 大腿长
  const SHIN_LEN = 95;          // 小腿长
  const FOOT_LIFT = 10;         // 脚踝在踏板上方 10px
  const PERIOD = 1200;          // 周期 1.2s，与轮子同步

  const thigh = document.getElementById('thigh');
  const shin  = document.getElementById('shin');
  const foot  = document.getElementById('foot');
  const crankArm = document.getElementById('crankArm');
  const pedal = document.getElementById('pedal');

  let virtualTime = 0; // 虚拟时间(ms)，供 svg_to_mp4 注入
  let lastReal = performance.now();

  // 两圆交点求膝盖: hip 与 ankle 为两端, 半径 THIGH_LEN / SHIN_LEN
  function solveKnee(hip, ankle){
    let dx = ankle.x - hip.x, dy = ankle.y - hip.y;
    let d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    // 若超出可达范围, 按比例夹紧
    const maxD = THIGH_LEN + SHIN_LEN;
    if(d > maxD){
      const s = maxD / d;
      ankle = {x: hip.x + dx*s, y: hip.y + dy*s};
      dx = ankle.x - hip.x; dy = ankle.y - hip.y; d = maxD;
    }
    if(d < 1) d = 1;
    // 标准两圆交点
    const a = (THIGH_LEN*THIGH_LEN - SHIN_LEN*SHIN_LEN + d*d) / (2*d);
    const h2 = THIGH_LEN*THIGH_LEN - a*a;
    const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, h2));
    const mx = hip.x + a*dx/d, my = hip.y + a*dy/d;
    // 取靠前的交点(膝盖朝前/朝上, 选 x 较大的)
    const ox = -dy/d * h, oy = dx/d * h;
    const k1 = {x: mx + ox, y: my + oy};
    const k2 = {x: mx - ox, y: my - oy};
    return (k1.x >= k2.x) ? k1 : k2;
  }

  function render(t){
    const theta = (t / PERIOD) * Math.PI * 2;
    // 踏板位置
    const px = CRANK_CENTER.x + CRANK_LEN * Math.cos(theta);
    const py = CRANK_CENTER.y + CRANK_LEN * Math.sin(theta);
    // 脚踝 = 踏板上方 10px
    const ankle = {x: px, y: py - FOOT_LIFT};
    // 曲柄
    crankArm.setAttribute('x1', CRANK_CENTER.x);
    crankArm.setAttribute('y1', CRANK_CENTER.y);
    crankArm.setAttribute('x2', px);
    crankArm.setAttribute('y2', py);
    // 踏板
    pedal.setAttribute('x', px - 17);
    pedal.setAttribute('y', py - 8);
    // 脚
    foot.setAttribute('cx', ankle.x);
    foot.setAttribute('cy', ankle.y);
    // 膝盖
    const knee = solveKnee(HIP, ankle);
    thigh.setAttribute('x1', HIP.x); thigh.setAttribute('y1', HIP.y);
    thigh.setAttribute('x2', knee.x); thigh.setAttribute('y2', knee.y);
    shin.setAttribute('x1', knee.x); shin.setAttribute('y1', knee.y);
    shin.setAttribute('x2', ankle.x); shin.setAttribute('y2', ankle.y);
  }

  // 暴露外部时间注入接口 (供 svg_to_mp4 精确控制虚拟时间)
  window.__setAnimTime = function(ms){ virtualTime = ms; render(virtualTime); };

  function loop(now){
    const dt = now - lastReal;
    lastReal = now;
    virtualTime += dt;
    render(virtualTime);
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
